player_prompt.intro:
Kcemm ad tili Player {player_id} ara ad idir {colour} ({piece}) deg urar n Othello.
Tafkukemt inek d ad kemmɣer i ugar n iɣallen n tɣmrt nnek ɣef ussni n urar.
Deg wakud nnek, sers takkayt iɣef tɣmrt nnek ad tili ger n takkayin n imddukkal nnek - deg wakud amezwar (deffir, ɣef wakud neɣ s-tnid) - ger takkayt tamaynut nnek d takkayt n idd nnek. Akk takkayin n imddukkal nnek ad ttlin ɣer tɣmrt nnek.
Sɣer imik nnek deg usɣiwel '[row, col]'.
